title: DataEng Lab - Learning Path - Roadmap (#roadmap) (UNVERIFIED DRAFT, section split)

settings.title: Show the roadmap as a progression from fundamentals to production thinking.

settings.editor: From core fundamentals to advanced techniques, this roadmap should lay out clear, step-by-step guidance and curated resources so learners understand what to study, what to practice and what each stage unlocks next.

settings.title: From core concepts to modern platform habits

settings.editor: Data engineering feels overwhelming when tools show up as disconnected logos. This sequence creates a cleaner climb: first fluency, then architecture, then transformation discipline, then operations, then real-time thinking and trust.
Phase 01
Build the language, basic tools and mental model that make every later path easier to absorb.
Phase 02
Understand where data lands, how it is organized and why storage patterns shape later decisions.
Phase 03
Learn how raw data becomes trusted, reusable datasets with tests, documentation and modular workflows.
Phase 04
Operate pipelines through scheduling, dependencies, retries and monitoring expectations.
Phase 05
Move into event-driven data movement where freshness, throughput and real-time behavior matter.
Phase 06
Build trust with quality, lineage, ownership, documentation and clear operating standards.
Get comfortable with Python, SQL and the core concepts that explain what a data engineer actually does day to day.
PythonSQLCore concepts
